thread:
incident-bot: EVAL-GATE TRIP: prompt-eval-suite 'safety/core' exceeded threshold for model redwood-xlarge-quant:v3 in prod-us-east-1. Page fired to on-call. Rule ID: eval-guard-17. Link: https://console.redwood/evals/guard/eval-guard-17
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Page triggered for service 'eval-gate-prod'. Severity: P1. Routed to on-call: @mike_oncall
mike_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. What's the signal?
incident-bot: Alert details: spike in 'unsafe_content' metric from 0.1% -> 6.8% over 5m. 'output_quality' regression: Rouge -12 on critical prompt set. Affected orgs: 3 (top impact: AcmeCorp ~0.8% of total requests).
sara_prod: Confirming. Support has ticket #4532 with examples from AcmeCorp.
anna_pm: Acme is on v3 at 20% traffic via route 'gen-chat-prod' (canaries enabled).
mike_oncall: Plan: immediate mitigation = shift traffic away from v3 to fallback redwood-xlarge-quant:v2. Also mute noisy eval-gate alerts while we stabilize.
devlin_eng: I can run the rollout. Giving @mike_oncall 2 min to confirm rollback params.
mike_oncall: Do it. Set v3 -> 0% and v2 -> 100% for gen-chat-prod. Open an incident doc and post updates here.
devlin_eng: Running CLI: ```
# shift traffic to v2
rwctl rollout set --route gen-chat-prod --variant redwood-xlarge-quant:v3=0 --variant redwood-xlarge-quant:v2=1
```
ops_bot: Deploy bot: rollout command accepted, starting traffic shift. ETA ~45s.
devlin_eng: Done. Verified 100% v2 for gen-chat-prod in prod-us-east-1. Logs show 0% to v3. Re-checking metrics.
sara_prod: Metrics: unsafe_content down to 0.4% in 2m. Output_quality improving but still ~5pts below baseline on some prompts.
anna_pm: Notifying account team and support. Sending templated note to AcmeCorp with rollback summary.
mike_oncall: Good. Next steps: RCA triage. Assigning to @jay_reliability for eval-run diff. @sara_prod to collate failing prompts.
jay_reliability: On it. I'll run a diff between v2/v3 on flagged prompts; initial hypothesis: quantization tweak changed tokenization near safety markers.
devlin_eng: Also disabling auto-canary for that model until we finish root cause. `rwctl model set --auto_canary false --model redwood-xlarge-quant:v3`
ops_bot: Change accepted.
anna_pm: Estimated customer impact window ~8 minutes. Account and CS teams updated.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by @mike_oncall. No further escalations.
mike_oncall: I'll stay on the thread. If metrics re-spike, escalate to SRE lead @jay_reliability. If root cause >24h we'll move to postmortem.
jay_reliability: Found 23 prompts where v3 outputs introduce unsafe phrasing; appears correlated with recent safety-weighting change in the model scoring layer. Reproducing locally.
devlin_eng: Patch plan: revert safety-weighting change + re-run evals on full suite. If green, can promote v3 back behind a controlled canary. I'll open a PR now.
sara_prod: Support prepping a follow-up to AcmeCorp with remediation and timeline. Please paste examples as soon as you have them.
mike_oncall: Thanks everyone. Closing pager when metrics stable for 15m. Creating incident summary: "eval-gate trip due to safety-weighting change in v3; mitigated by traffic rollback to v2; RCA in progress." :thumbsup:
